title: WP-VAL-A: freeze the badf-release-validation capability contract (G09 independent pre-release validation router; DESIGNED)
objective: Freeze badf-release-validation as the G09 independent pre-release validation ORCHESTRATOR (a risk-routed evidence federation over the four G09 evidence types the lifecycle already names), explicitly NOT a G10 release-readiness / go-no-go authority. G09 stays quality_authority-owned; G10 stays release_authority-owned; that split is untouched. The capability derives a validation-obligation set (quality / security / performance / resilience classes) from declared risk, changed surfaces, NFRs, threat model, security obligations and change class -- not a static 'run all QA' checklist. Each class carries its own risk hypothesis, method, oracle, execution identity, runtime result and non-coverage; approved runtimes establish observable facts; agent output is draft until validated and bound; every artifact binds the EXACT G08-verified candidate; the G09 dossier is conjunctive (a security blocker cannot be outvoted). Passing one class says nothing about another. Passing G09 establishes pre-release validation evidence -- not UAT, not operational readiness, not release authority. DESIGNED rung: SKILL.md + references only.
business_value: G09 currently names four evidence types with no authoring capability to route, bind and normalize them. This freezes a strong model -- an evidence federation of independent validation disciplines against one immutable candidate, each with its own oracle/runtime/provenance/thresholds/findings/non-coverage -- so the later rungs can enforce it deterministically without a competing validator and without leaking G10 release authority into G09.
